title: Steve Gadd, the Mickey Mouse Club contest and tap lessons
summary: At a Mickey Mouse Club audition Steve Gadd won by tap dancing, so their father made the boys take tap lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I’ve tried to get with him. But maybe I need a phone number from somebody. He came a long way from the Ted Mack Amateur Hour.
Yeah well now that was the Mickey Mouse Club when he —
We were at Sibley’s audition — this was for the big Mickey Mouse Club contest, and Steve won because he could tap dance and play drums. I’ll never forgive him for that.

No, my father went up to — I forgot the guy’s name, who was the celebrity that died? Dean? Not Dean. Anyway Pop went up to him and said, “How come you chose him?” He says, “Well he could tap dance too. Your kids don’t tap dance, they could just play music.”
Well I guess you’re lucky that your father didn’t, you know, call a rehearsal and say, “Okay fellas, I’ve got tap shoes for ya.”
No he made us go take dance lessons.
Oh yeah, we had to go take tap dance lessons after that. It didn’t last very long, I couldn’t stand it.
